settings.heading: I learned to manage the hard way
settings.text:
I was promoted to lead a team of nine at twenty six, the week after I had been one of them. I made most of the mistakes my clients make now, usually twice.

Since then I have led teams for fourteen years and coached managers in software, retail, agencies and hospitals. The problems are almost always the same: doing too much yourself, feedback put off, and meetings that decide nothing.
settings.fact_2: Works with: Managers in their first years
settings.fact_3: Sessions: On video or in person

settings.heading: From the first call to a plan you use
settings.text: No long questionnaire and no theory. We work on your real team and your real calendar from week one.

settings.title: A free call
settings.text: You tell me about your team and what is hard right now. I tell you honestly whether I can help, and how.

settings.title: Look at your week
settings.text: Where your hours go, who needs what from you and what only you can do. One page that shows it.

settings.title: Pick three changes
settings.text: Not twenty. Three habits with the most effect, each with a first step this week.

settings.title: Do the work, check in
settings.text: We meet, look at what moved and what did not, and adjust. You keep the plan between calls.

settings.heading: Six months in, managers tell me
settings.text: Every team is different, so these are examples from past work, not promises.

settings.title: They hand work over and leave it
settings.text: Clear outcomes, a check in date, and no taking it back.

settings.title: Feedback is a habit, not an event
settings.text: Small and often, in one to ones that happen every week.

settings.title: The team decides more on its own
settings.text: Written answers to the usual questions, and trust to use them.

settings.title: Meetings end with a decision
settings.text: An agenda, an owner and notes anyone can read.

settings.title: There is a plan for the quarter
settings.text: Written down, shared with the team, looked at every month.

settings.title: Evenings are back
settings.text: Not every one. Most of them.

settings.heading: Bring it to your team or your event
settings.text: Half day and full day workshops on delegation, feedback and meetings, for leadership teams, company offsites and conferences.

settings.heading: Let's look at your week
settings.text: Twenty minutes on video. You tell me about your team; I say honestly whether I can help.
settings.note: No pitch. If we are not a fit, I will say so.

What is taking your time
